DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' for queries on 'Sai Baba Industries' Gwalior GST/GeM/tender, and volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. Domestic supply therefore not verified either way — null, not public via available tools.
note: Real export shipments are documented: hulled sesame seeds HS 12074090 ex Mundra/Kandla to Egypt (Sokhna), Philippines (Manila) and Iraq (Umm Qasr) with B/L numbers and dates in Feb 2026, plus raw sesame imports from Brazil — so the company is an active processor/trader of sesame, not a mere claimant. Declared HS set (100850;120740;120799;121190) is consistent with the observed 12074090; no HS correction needed. Role: manufacturer_trader (imports raw seed, exports hulled seed). Note the customs address is Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, while the claimed contact 'MANOJ CHAUDHARY' and PAN/state were not independently verified — no PAN/CIN found in public sources, left null. Domestic (India) supply side remains unverified: no GST turnover, GeM/CPPP or contract evidence was obtainable, so domestic_status is unknown rather than confirmed. Caveat: only 5 of the 259 claimed shipment rows were visible on the free page; the 259 figure is the source's own counter, not independently counted.
